summary: Full adversarial verification of the PAT-removal directive (10-item review). All 10 items PASS on preview. Backend live tests + direct-service call + real GitHub App drill against the disposable testbed all green. No live PAT-helper references remain in backend routers/ or services/. Frontend RevokedRepoBanner.jsx renders the distinct amber 'unreachable' state with data-testid='github-unreachable-banner' before the red revoked banner.

critical_code_review_comments: cto_projects.py is 3804 lines — split into smaller modules (repo verify, project CRUD, tasks, chat handoff) at some point; not blocking for this directive.

AddProject.github_token field is still in the request Pydantic model (line 132) — kept intentionally so the router can return an honest 400 instead of silently ignoring an unknown field. OK; consider adding a Field(deprecated=True) description for OpenAPI clarity.

The GitHub App runtime config hydration on cold-start is async and can race the first admin call after boot (observed one initial 499 on /pat-inventory ~2s after supervisor restart, resolved on retry). Consider `await`ing hydration in the startup path before opening the port, or an internal readiness probe.
